title: P-auth1: fixed-membership room removal rule
description: room-policy-04 §5 fixed_membership: 'ordinary users cannot leave or be removed', but 'ordinary' is undefined and authorize() does not take BaseRoomPolicy. Readings: (a) deny every removal in a fixed-membership room; (b) 'ordinary' = roles without canRemoveParticipant; (c) not enforced in v1. Chosen by Mark 2026-10-17: (c), not enforced in v1; documented in # Limitations. wg item filed.
